intQpBar p x ≤ intQpBar p y ↔ ‖x‖ ≤ ‖y‖

inst@L185.label: Finite character groups
inst@L185.description: The group of homomorphisms from a finite abelian group to the rationals modulo the integers is finite.
evidence: A finite abelian group `A` has exactly `#A` homomorphisms to `ℚ/ℤ`

inst@L262.label: Uniform continuity of scaling
inst@L262.description: For each fixed p-adic integer, multiplication by that integer is uniformly continuous on the p-adic algebraic closure.

inst@L315.label: Flatness of stalk spectra
inst@L315.description: The map from the spectrum of a scheme’s stalk to the scheme is flat.
evidence: instance {Z : Scheme} (s : Z) : Flat (fromSpecStalk Z s)

inst@L456.label: Complex normed subspaces
inst@L456.description: A complex submodule of a complex normed space inherits a normed space structure.
evidence: A submodule of a complex normed space is a normed space over ℂ
